title: ヒンジ式ケーブル保護ブリッジ
description: 3本の開放端ケーブル通路、黄色いヒンジ蓋、滑り止めを備えるケーブル保護ブリッジ。ケーブルは含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A three-channel cable-crossing bridge with open ends, hinged yellow lid, latches and raised grips; cables not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
